messages:
matt: FYI PR #9001 landed to feature branch and the canary. quick smokebench shows a noticeable tail jump on the 4k longseq profile. attaching high-level artifact: https://ci.redwood/bench/pr-9001/index.html

aliza: saw a spike earlier this morning on canary. can you paste the short summary numbers here?

matt: short summary:
- baseline p95 (4k-longseq, prefill=true): 118ms
- post-change p95 (same config): 225ms
- throughput ~unchanged, resident memory stable
artifacts: s3://perf-artifacts/pr-9001/smokebench/index.html

kenji: is the regression only with prefill? can you mention batch_size / config used?

matt: batch_size=4, prefill=true by default. I'll run a microbench with prefill=false and post results in ~5m

ciara: pinging @platform-ops in case we need to block the canary. if it's tail-only we might prefer revert + follow-up patch.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed: pr-9001 -> canary-pool at 2026-03-17T22:34:12Z :white_check_mark:

matt: kenji results just in: prefill=false microbench p95=130ms (close to baseline). prefill=true still p95=223ms. quick heap/profile points to GC/alloc pauses around the long requests

kenji: can you share the heap profile and a tiny log snip? want to confirm contention vs allocation churn

matt: heap dump: s3://perf-artifacts/pr-9001/heapdump.gz; log snip below:
```
[2026-03-17T22:36:01Z] alloc: compacting 48MB free, pause 18ms
[2026-03-17T22:36:02Z] kv-cache: prefill write 2MB
[2026-03-17T22:36:03Z] alloc: mutex contended, wait 12ms
```

aliza: quick read of the PR diff suggests we added a coarse mutex in alloc::prefill() to guard a rare path. short requests don't hit it enough to notice; longseq + prefill accumulates contention. can you link the diff line?

matt: diff: https://git.redwood/pr/9001/files#diff-alloc-mutex. I'm leaning toward reverting the mutex change as a hotfix. open to other ideas if someone has a minimal patch to reduce contended region

ciara: for speed, revert and open a follow-up fix. need approvals for revert and a bench proving the revert restores p95.

kenji: posted microbench artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/micro-9001.json. TL;DR: prefill=true p95=220ms, prefill=false p95=128ms. CPU profile shows stack heavy in alloc::prefill_lock waiting.

matt: thanks. I'll open a revert PR (temporary) and mark pr-9001 blocked. anyone object to revert? :thinking_face:

aliza: no objection, revert now. please also add a small e2e that exercises longseq-prefill for the regression guard.

platform-ops: ack — prefer revert now to minimize customer exposure. we'll schedule a small postmortem with root cause follow-up after revert. :thumbsup:

matt: created revert PR: https://git.redwood/pr/9002 and flagged as cherrypick/fix-later. holding merge until reviewers + bench verification on revert. I'll update when revert merges. Thanks all!

ciara: nice work triaging. once revert is in, let's run a quick canary sweep across 2 regions and then un-block mainline.

matt: will do. posting final note when complete.
